units.source_text: 夕雾左大臣赶紧准备六女公子与匂亲王的婚事，日子选定在八月内。

en.t: Minister of the Left Yugiri hurried to prepare the marriage between his sixth daughter and Prince Niou, and the date was set for sometime in the eighth month.

units.source_text: 二条院的二女公子闻之，想道：“果然不出所料！

en.t: When the second daughter at Nijo-in heard this, she thought, "It is just as I expected!

units.source_text: 哪里会没事呢？

en.t: How could nothing come of it?

units.source_text: 我早就料到：像我这样微不足道的人，定会遭逢不幸，惹人耻笑。

en.t: I knew all along that someone as insignificant as I am would surely meet with misfortune and become a laughingstock.

units.source_text: 早就知道此人生性浮薄，甚不可靠。

en.t: I knew from the start that he was frivolous by nature and quite unreliable.

units.source_text: 但接近以后，倒也看不出无情之相，并且对我立下山盟海誓。

en.t: But after I grew close to him, he did not seem heartless, and he even swore solemn vows of love to me.

units.source_text: 今后他另有新欢，对我突然疏远之时，叫我怎能沉得住气呢？

en.t: When he finds a new love and suddenly grows distant from me, how could I possibly remain calm?

units.source_text: 即使不像身份低微的人那样和我一刀两断，但痛苦之事一定甚多。

en.t: Even if he does not cut me off completely, as he might with a woman of low rank, there will surely be much suffering.

units.source_text: 我身毕竟命苦，恐怕结果非回山中不可了。”

en.t: In the end my fate is a bitter one, and I fear I will have no choice but to return to the mountains."

units.source_text: 她觉得做了弃妇回去而被山中人耻笑，比终身闭居在山中更没面子。

en.t: She felt that returning as an abandoned woman and being mocked by the people in the mountains would be more shameful than spending her whole life shut away there.

units.source_text: 违背了亡父生前反复教诫的遗言而轻率地离开了蔓草滋生的山庄，今日始知可耻可痛！

en.t: Only now did she feel the shame and pain of having gone against the repeated admonitions her late father had left her and rashly left the weed-grown mountain villa.

units.source_text: 她想：“已故的姐姐，从外表看来，什么事情都随意不拘，没有主见，但她心底里意志坚定，不可动摇。

en.t: She thought, "My late sister may have seemed outwardly casual in everything and lacking firm opinions, but deep in her heart her will was strong and unshakable.

units.source_text: 真是了不起的人！

en.t: She truly was an extraordinary person!

units.source_text: 薰中纳言至今时刻不忘记她，终日悲伤叹息。

en.t: Counselor Kaoru still has not forgotten her for a moment, and spends his days grieving and sighing.

units.source_text: 倘姐姐不死而嫁给了他，恐怕也会遭逢此种事情呢。

en.t: If my sister had not died and had married him, perhaps she too would have encountered this sort of thing.

units.source_text: 但她计虑甚深，决不上他的当，千方百计地距远他，甚至立意削发为尼。

en.t: But she was deeply thoughtful, would never fall into his snare, kept him at a distance by every possible means, and even resolved to cut her hair and become a nun.

units.source_text: 如果她还在世，一定做尼姑了。

en.t: If she were still alive, she would certainly have become a nun.

units.source_text: 至今思之，姐姐何等贤明啊！

en.t: Thinking of it now, how wise my sister was!

units.source_text: 父亲和姐姐的亡魂看到我这般光景，定在责我轻率无知了。”

en.t: Seeing me in this state, the spirits of my father and sister must surely be reproaching me for my rashness and ignorance."

units.source_text: 她又觉可耻，又觉可悲。

en.t: She felt both ashamed and sorrowful.

units.source_text: 然而现已无可奈何，又何必抱怨呢？

en.t: But now nothing could be done, so what was the use of complaining?

units.source_text: 便隐忍在心，只装作不知道六女公子之事。

en.t: So she kept her feelings hidden in her heart and merely pretended not to know about the sixth daughter.

units.source_text: 匂亲王近来对二女公子比往常更加亲热了，无论朝起夜寝，都情深意密地和她谈话。

en.t: Recently Prince Niou had become even more affectionate toward the second daughter than before, and whether rising in the morning or going to bed at night, he spoke with her tenderly and intimately.

units.source_text: 又和她誓约：不但今世，生生世世永为夫妇。

en.t: He also vowed to her that they would remain husband and wife not only in this life, but through all lives to come.
